notes.title: Bacon Rebellion Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello!
If you liked any of my previous games, I thought to let you know that my newest game - Bacon Rebellion is out now!
It's a small and silly top-down shooter game about angry rampaging pigs. Grab your shotgun and put an end to this Bacon Rebellion!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/415780/Bacon_Rebellion/
